items.title: Konitz Lee — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: we played in one band, the Harold Fox, “Jimmy Dale” he was known as

ctx.x: Right, exactly. You also knew Jimmy Rainey and Lou Levy in high school right?
Yeah, right. We went to different high schools but we played in one band, the Harold Fox, “Jimmy Dale” he was known as, the local tailor had a band.
They were supposed to have been quite good, right?
